translations.en: 7 – Yahya ibn Zakariyya, al-Tarmashiri, Abu al-Husayn.

en.summary: This entry from al-Ghada'iri's *Kitab al-Du'afa* identifies Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Tarmashiri as a 'Wadda'' (fabricator), a specific technical term in Shia hadith criticism denoting one who invents narrations to support their own views or sect. His designation highlights the rigorous scrutiny applied to narrators to ensure the authenticity of the Imams' teachings, distinguishing mere weakness from active fabrication.
en.seo_question: Who is Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Tarmashiri in Shia hadith sciences?
